_about: Class edition for teenage learners. Applied on top of week*.json by tools/build_audio.py --edition class. Notes avoid references to Russian or German and to case names; adult lines are replaced.

0.en: Do you have a brother or a sister?
0.answer_en: Yes, I have a brother and a sister.

1.answer_en: My brother is five years old.

2.answer_en: No, I don't have a dog. I have a cat.

3.answer_en: My school is in the centre.

3.en: Shall we go for an ice cream?

0.answer_en: A glass of apple juice, please.

w01-d01-s02.grammar_note: {ste} is 'you are', when speaking politely or to several people.

w01-d01-s10.grammar_note: After {v}, meaning 'in', the ending changes: {Ljubljana} becomes {v Ljubljani}.

w01-d02-s02.grammar_note: When you ask for something, the ending changes: {ena kava} becomes {eno kavo}.

w01-d02-s03.grammar_note: After {z}, meaning 'with', the ending changes: {mleko} becomes {z mlekom}. And {ali} means 'or'.

w01-d02-s08.grammar_note: With five or more, the ending changes: {pet evrov}.

w01-d03-s06.grammar_note: {nimamo} is 'we don't have'. After it the ending changes: {rogljički} becomes {rogljičkov}.

w01-d03-s07.grammar_note: Slovenian has a special form for exactly two of something: {dva bureka}.

w01-d04-s01.en: Do you have a brother or a sister?
w01-d04-s01.grammar_note: {imaš} is 'you have', said to a friend. To an adult you say {imate}.

w01-d04-s02.en: Yes, I have a brother and a sister.

w01-d04-s03.grammar_note: {sta} is 'the two of them are'. Slovenian has special forms for two people. For three or more it would be {so stari}.

w01-d04-s04.en: My brother is five years old.
w01-d04-s04.grammar_note: {leto} is a year. {pet let}: five years.

w01-d04-s05.grammar_note: Here {pa} means 'and as for'. Three and four years are {leta}; five and more are {let}.

w01-d04-s06.en: Do you also have a dog?

w01-d04-s08.grammar_note: {tvoja} is 'your', said to a friend. {šola} is school.

w01-d04-s09.en: My school is in the centre.

w01-d05-s01.grammar_note: {ura} is both hour and clock. Literally 'how much is the hour'.

w01-d05-s03.grammar_note: {čas} is time in general. An hour is {ura}.

w01-d05-s04.grammar_note: After {nimam}, 'I don't have', the ending changes: {čas} becomes {časa}.

w01-d05-s07.en: Shall we go for an ice cream?
w01-d05-s07.grammar_note: {greva} is 'the two of us go'. With three or more people it is {gremo}. And {sladoled} is ice cream.

w01-d05-s09.grammar_note: Clock times use {ob}: {ob petih}, at five.

w01-d05-s10.grammar_note: {se vidiva} means 'the two of us see each other'.

w02-d01-s02.grammar_note: {učim se} is 'I am learning'. Without the little word {se}, {učim} means 'I teach'.

w02-d01-s04.en: Thank you. I speak English and German.

w02-d01-s06.grammar_note: 'Can' is the word {lahko} plus a normal verb: {lahko ponovite}, you can repeat.

w02-d01-s10.grammar_note: {ni problema} is 'no problem'. {Dobro vam gre} is literally 'it goes well for you'.

w02-d02-s02.grammar_note: After an amount, the ending changes: {jabolka} becomes {kilo jabolk}.

w02-d02-s05.grammar_note: The special form for two: {dva evra}. Five was {pet evrov}.

w02-d02-s09.grammar_note: After {s}, meaning 'with', the ending changes: {kartica} becomes {s kartico}. {s} and {z} are the same word; the next sound decides which one you use.

w02-d03-s01.grammar_note: Going to a place is {v center}. Being in a place is {v centru}.

w02-d03-s07.grammar_note: {čez} with a time means 'in': {čez pet minut}.

w02-d04-s01.grammar_note: A table is {miza}. A chair is {stol}.

w02-d04-s03.grammar_note: This is the future: {boste pili}, you will drink.

w02-d04-s04.en: A glass of apple juice, please.
w02-d04-s04.grammar_note: {kozarec} is a glass. {jabolčni sok} is apple juice.

w02-d04-s08.grammar_note: {Vam je všeč} is literally 'is it pleasing to you'. That is how Slovenian says 'do you like it'.

w02-d04-s09.grammar_note: The little word {je} comes second: {zelo je dobro}.

w02-d05-s04.grammar_note: {škoda} is 'what a pity'. After 'I don't like', the ending changes: {dež} becomes {dežja}.

w02-d05-s08.sl: Z očetom. Mama je pri babici.
w02-d05-s08.en: With my dad. Mum is at grandma's.
chunks: Z očetom. Mama je pri babici.
